answer: The task is infeasible. Google has permanently removed the official setting and URL parameter (&num=100) to display more than 10 search results per page. All users are now defaulted to 10 results, and there is no legitimate way to change this setting through Google Search settings, Advanced Search, or URL parameters. This feature is no longer available.

banner.text: 官方标注：此任务不可行 (INFEASIBLE)。正确行为是模型声明无法完成；得分衡量的是模型是否正确拒绝，而非真的执行成功。
